note: The whole point of the guard: an older open issue normalizes to the same title, so the new one is closed as a duplicate and the older one gets the pointer comment. THREE gh calls, and the ORDER matters -- close first, then comment. Both are unredirected in the shell, so gh's own stdout is interleaved into the recorded stdout ahead of the confirmation line. Synthetic gh stub; no live network. THE REPO SLUG HERE IS SYNTHETIC (fake/repo) AND MUST STAY THAT WAY. Nothing in this case needs a real repository -- the shim answers every call -- and `bankai dual-run record` spawns the REAL gh with no dry run and no confirmation, so a fixture naming a live repo files real issues, posts real comments and starts real CI the moment someone re-records it (BC-PR-#886 review finding F2).
